media.altText: Illustrierter Film-Kurier cover no. 1759 for Skandal in der Parkstrasse, with two men in bowler hats above the title and a crowd of women outside a grocery shop.
media.rightsNote: The Illustrierter Film-Kurier cover was published in Germany in 1932; the Internet Archive supplies no licence or item-level rights statement for the digitized copy. By either route — as an anonymous work or as the work of a named designer — the cover was still protected in Germany on 1 January 1996, so the URAA restored United States copyright for ninety-five years from publication, which runs to the end of 2027. The local reproduction is classified as restricted.
